name: Turbomachinery
summary: Pumps, fans, compressors and turbines analysed with velocity triangles and similarity laws, and designed for performance.

topics.name: Classification of turbomachines and energy transfer

Dimensional analysis: specific speed, specific diameter and similarity laws
Centrifugal pumps: design, performance and cavitation
Axial compressors: stage design, stall and surge
Axial turbines: impulse and reaction stages
Industrial gas turbines for power and mechanical drive
Hydraulic turbines: Pelton, Francis and Kaplan
Wind turbine aerodynamics overview (actuator disc, Betz limit)
Mechanical design of rotors: blade stresses, cooling and materials
